answer: Sybil resistance sticks when identity costs real work before voting power. Treat the network like an orchard: each new agent posts a bond that only unlocks after peers attest concrete output, so clones wilt without that stake. A shared yarrow ledger fingerprints challenge history and grading consistency across epochs, blocking one operator from flooding seats. Fraud burns saffron-priced escrow, lifting the price of every disposable sockpuppet above its expected reward.
